59: 
60: The argument to ``ament_python_install_package()`` is the name of the directory alongside the ``CMakeLists.txt`` that contains the Python file.
61: In this case, it is ``my_project``, or ``${PROJECT_NAME}``.
62: 
63: .. warning::
64: 
65:    Calling ``rosidl_generate_interfaces`` and ``ament_python_install_package`` in the same CMake project does not work.
66:    See this `Github issue <https://github.com/ros2/rosidl_python/issues/141>`_ for more info.
67:    It is best practice to instead separate out the message generation into a separate package.
68: 
69: Then, another Python package that correctly depends on ``my_project`` can use it as a normal Python module:
70: 
71: .. code-block:: python
72: 
73:    from my_project.my_script import my_function

39: 1 Create a new package
40: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
41: 
42: For this tutorial you will be creating custom ``.msg`` and ``.srv`` files in their own package, and then utilizing them in a separate package.
43: Both packages should be in the same workspace.
44: 
45: Since we will use the pub/sub and service/client packages created in earlier tutorials, make sure you are in the same workspace as those packages (``ros2_ws/src``), and then run the following command to create a new package:
46: 
47: .. code-block:: console
48: 
49:   $ ros2 pkg create --build-type ament_cmake --license Apache-2.0 tutorial_interfaces
50: 
51: ``tutorial_interfaces`` is the name of the new package.
52: Note that it is, and can only be, an ament_cmake package, but this doesn't restrict in which type of packages you can use your messages and services.
53: You can create your own custom interfaces in an ament_cmake package, and then use it in a C++ or Python node, which will be covered in the last section.
54: 
55: The ``.msg`` and ``.srv`` files are required to be placed in directories called ``msg`` and ``srv`` respectively.
56: Create the directories in ``ros2_ws/src/tutorial_interfaces``:
57: 
58: .. code-block:: console
59: 
107:   find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
108:   find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)
109: 
110:   rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
111:     "msg/Num.msg"
112:     "msg/Sphere.msg"
113:     "srv/AddThreeInts.srv"
114:     DEPENDENCIES geometry_msgs # Add packages that above messages depend on, in this case geometry_msgs for Sphere.msg
115:   )
116: 
117: .. note::
118: 
119:   The first argument (library name) in the ``rosidl_generate_interfaces`` must start with the name of the package, e.g., simply ``${PROJECT_NAME}`` or ``${PROJECT_NAME}_suffix``.
120:   See https://github.com/ros2/rosidl/issues/441#issuecomment-591025515.
121: 
122: 4 ``package.xml``
123: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
124: 
125: Because the interfaces rely on ``rosidl_default_generators`` for generating language-specific code, you need to declare a build tool dependency on it.
